seo.title: Landscaping in Greater Victoria, BC | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: Grounds maintenance, landscape installation, irrigation and tree care for homes, stratas and businesses in Greater Victoria. Free, site-specific quotes.

h1: Landscaping, grounds care, irrigation and tree work in Greater Victoria
lede: One local contractor for four services, for homes, stratas and commercial sites. We check the local rules first and tell you what happens next.

process.heading: How it works
process.lede: Four steps from your first message to scheduled work.

reviewsBand.heading: What clients say
reviewsBand.lede: From homeowners, strata councils and contractors. A quote marked Sample is an example, not a review from a client.

localExpertise.heading: Local rules, handled
body: Tree bylaws, watering schedules and well rules differ from one municipality to the next. We check the rules for your address before work starts, and each area page links to the official source.

sections.heading: What we do
body: Four services from one contractor and one point of contact, so fewer things fall between trades.

items.title: Grounds maintenance
items.body: Mowing, bed care, pruning and seasonal cleanups on a set schedule. [See grounds maintenance](/services/grounds-maintenance/).

items.title: Landscape installation
items.body: Planting, sod, patios, paths and retaining walls. [See landscape installation](/services/landscape-installation/).

items.title: Irrigation
items.body: Installation, repairs, spring start-up and winterization. [See irrigation](/services/irrigation/).

items.title: Tree and vegetation
items.body: Pruning, removals, invasive plants and clearing. [See tree and vegetation](/services/tree-vegetation/).

items.title: Rules checked first
items.body: We check CRD watering rules and your municipality's tree bylaw before we start, and point you to the official source.

items.title: A written scope
items.body: Your quote says what we will do, how often and when, so you see the scope before the first visit.

items.title: One contact
items.body: One person to call for questions, changes and owner concerns.

items.title: Homeowners
items.body: A tidy, healthy yard without managing it yourself.

items.title: Stratas and property managers
items.body: A seasonal plan you can take to council and notes after each visit. [Strata and commercial service](/commercial/).

items.title: Commercial and public buyers
items.body: Work to your specification. Insurance and safety details are on our [commercial page](/commercial/).

sections.heading: Where we work
body: We work across Greater Victoria, from Sidney to Sooke. [See all service areas](/areas/).

sections.heading: Sample projects
body: Examples of the kind of work we do. Each one is labelled Sample. [Browse the portfolio](/portfolio/).

sections.heading: Ready to talk about your property?
body: Tell us what you need on our quote form. We reply within [REPLY TIME] and arrange a site visit if the job needs one.
